changes: Amudi escaped HTML and divided the existing source text into numbered reading sections, preserving word order. Source-page labels are provider file numbers, not independently established printed daf coordinates. coverageStatus: Three supplied volumes, including source appendices. Numbered source-file gaps remain documented. 629 reading sections imported. Automatically digitized source; samples were reviewed, but not proofread word by word.
sourceProduction: Existing provider digital text, originally digitized using automatic processing; Amudi did not run OCR.
qualityReview: Every input checked for decoding corruption, controls, numbering gaps and duplicate substantial pages. Representative beginning/middle/end samples read for identity and coherence; this is not a word-perfect proofreading claim.
